title: A Letter About a Job
text:
Dear Mr. Smith,
I am writing to ask about the job of office assistant. I saw the advert on your website last week. I have two years of experience in an office.

I can use computer programs and I speak good English. I have attached my CV to this letter. I look forward to hearing from you.

Yours sincerely,
Anna Nowak

questions.text: Where did the writer see the advert?
How much office experience does the writer have?
Why does the writer attach a CV to the letter?
options: To give more information about her skills

questions.text: What is the writer's tone in the letter?

vocabulary.definition: a short public message that tries to sell a product or find a worker
knowledge or skill that you get from doing a job or activity
sent together with another document, such as in an email or letter
to feel happy and excited about something that will happen in the future

paragraph_translations:
Szanowny Panie Smith,
piszę, aby zapytać o pracę asystenta biurowego. Widziałam ogłoszenie na Pana stronie internetowej w zeszłym tygodniu. Mam dwa lata doświadczenia w biurze.

Potrafię obsługiwać programy komputerowe i dobrze mówię po angielsku. Moje CV jest załączone do tego listu. Z niecierpliwością czekam na odpowiedź.

Z poważaniem,
Anna Nowak
